column1: # Disease ontology-id seed list for SideEffect2Cure AI (Level 1).
# This file is an INPUT PARAMETER, not data: it lists which diseases the
# prototype ingests. Disease names and every disease-gene association are
# fetched from the Open Targets Platform at ingest time (nothing here is a
# biomedical claim). Edit this list to widen or narrow disease scope.
# Format: one ontology id per line (EFO_* / MONDO_*). Text after '#' and blank
# lines are ignored. Ids that no longer resolve in Open Targets are reported
